definitions.explanation: The sixth day of the week. A short form of {土曜日|どようび}.

examples.japanese: {土曜|どよう}は{休|やす}みです。
{今度|こんど}の{土曜|どよう}に{映画|えいが}を{見|み}に{行|い}こう。
examples.english: Let's go see a movie this Saturday.

examples.japanese: {毎週|まいしゅう}{土曜|どよう}の{午前中|ごぜんちゅう}はジムに{通|かよ}っている。
examples.english: I go to the gym every Saturday morning.

notes:
The short form of {土曜日|どようび} (Saturday). Both forms are used interchangeably, but {土曜|どよう} is more common in compound expressions and abbreviated writing such as schedules and calendars.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {土曜|どよう}の{朝|あさ}: Saturday morning
- {土曜|どよう}の{夜|よる}: Saturday night
- {毎週|まいしゅう}{土曜|どよう}: every Saturday
- {土曜|どよう}{出勤|しゅっきん}: working on Saturday

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {土曜日|どようび}: Saturday — the full form; slightly more formal
- {日曜|にちよう}: Sunday — the following day of the week
- {金曜|きんよう}: Friday — the preceding day of the week
